name: RC-B10-0476/2026 – After § 4 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: 4b. Calls for independent, impartial and transparent investigations into all attacks on merchant shipping in the Black Sea, including those whose origin remains unclear, under the auspices of the UN and the International Maritime Organization (IMO); warns in the strongest terms against hasty attributions and against any automatic military response, given that a misattributed incident could become the trigger for a wider war;
